b.span: Block of memory with embedded header

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 347px; margin-left: 643px;

div.span: Grow the heap by using sbr() to extend the size of the heap:

li.span: Each new allocation includes an embedded header that tracks the capacity of the data block (not including the header) and the size actually used
Although blocks are contiguous, we need prev and next pointer to be able to traverse through them as a list since the allocations are not fixed size
